description: Use after running a check. Validates one to four evidence records against DoD items in the contract token: exit codes, test counts in the output, hashes, URL status and evidence level. It cannot see your machine; it checks structure and consistency only. Returns verdicts and an updated token.

out.description: Last lines of output, including the summary line

token.description: Contract token from start_flow_task or the last check

name: check_flow_evidence
title: Check evidence for DoD items
